shared_elements: low-relief carving of figures in strict profile
standing human figure in profile with arm raised/extended
bearded figure with elaborately curled/patterned hair
long fringed robe with belted waist
stylized surface pattern used as infill (feathering / fleece rendered as repeated scale-like units)
hoofed animal in profile (implied in A only via winged genie? no)
justification: Both surfaces show low-relief profile figures with the same conventions: strictly lateral bodies, elaborately curled/beaded beards and hair, long belted garments, forward-extended arms, and dense repeated scale-like patterning used as infill (wings in A, fleece in B). But the subjects differ substantially: A shows a single raptor-headed winged genie beside a stylized sacred plant with rosettes, whereas B shows a procession of ordinary human tribute-bearers leading horned rams, with no wings, hybrid creatures or vegetal motifs.
